title: Evaluate and implement a replaceable GeoIP suggestion provider
note: Native proposal validation, accepted merge and task completion remain separate required gates. This receipt does not mark the backlog complete.
known_limitations: This receipt is not a native completion or merge receipt.
The decision record, geoip.ts, and geoip.test.ts are untracked working-tree files. site_revision is HEAD before those edits.
artifacts/ is gitignored, so this receipt is on disk and is not part of git status.

GitHub Pages cannot read the visitor IP. The client calls https://api.country.is/ from the browser. The CORS check was a GET with Origin https://worldwidelaws.github.io and Origin https://wetwijzer.github.io from the evaluation host on 2026-10-30. It was not a browser executing on the Pages site.
Provider terms, quota, and retention were read on 2026-10-30 and can change. The decision record is that check. It is not a legal opinion that disclosure satisfies every ePrivacy rule.

The selected response includes an IP field. The parser drops it, along with any city, postal code, or coordinates, and does not write them to localStorage or sessionStorage. The raw body exists only while that response is parsed.

The kept suggestion is a country code. A country code is not a place id. With no resolver, the place stays unselected. A resolver may map the code to a stable country place id. A city or a bare country code is not applied.

The default sends one request for a new session that has no explicit place, with disclosure and a local opt-out. consentRequired waits for Suggest my approximate location. A failed attempt still consumes the one session request. There is no retry.
Search text, an address, and coordinates are refused before a request is built. The request is a queryless GET with credentials omit, redirect error, cache no-store, and referrerPolicy no-referrer.

Manual search stays available on every path. An explicit URL, session, or saved place is not replaced. A place chosen while the request is open is kept. Timeout, HTTP errors, an oversized body, and unreadable storage do not change the place or the search text.
country.is publishes no SLA. Self-hosting that service would require a MaxMind secret, which this static client does not use.
Device location, the place picker, and the privacy screen are later tasks.
node_modules was absent and was installed with npm ci --ignore-scripts so Jest could run. package.json and package-lock.json were not edited.

CI=1 was set so Jest would not enter watch mode. PATH was exactly /usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin. HOME was /tmp/ipfs-accelerate-validation-home-wwl032c. XDG paths were $HOME/.cache, $HOME/.config, $HOME/.local/share, and $HOME/.local/state.

The Jest reporter and the existing Node NO_COLOR and VM Modules warnings were written to stderr, along with the ts-jest isolatedModules deprecation warning. stderr was not empty. The process exit code was 0.
The reporter counted 24 passing tests. One is the existing setup test. Twenty-three exercise this provider.
This module does not decide that a law applies.
